units: <cite ref="Yoma 79b:9">Yoma 79ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 11:15">Deut. XI, 15</cite>) <he>אכילה שיש בה ש׳ וכ׳</he> (to say the benediction after meal requires) food enough to satisfy the appetite, which is the size of an egg.
Pesik. R. s. 16 (ref. to Num. XXVIII, 7) לשון רויה לשון ש׳ וכ׳ expressing fill, satiation &c., v. רְוִיָּה; Tanḥ. Pinḥ. 12; Num. R. s. 2117; Y. Succ. IV, 54ᵈ top שיבעה (corr. acc.).
